stage: Parent cadence result and prior sign-ledger known; before independent FITS/SIMLIB reparse and detailed error-column analysis.
rule: Independently parse original HEAD/PHOT pointers and every SIMLIB LIBID/FIELD/S optical row. Compare each of17 alias original FITS g/r/i/z epochs by field/band/abs MJD<=.00055 day; retain all ambiguities. Read RAISIN product directly for retention rather than trusting prior ledgers. error_rule: On author DES16 raw positive rows with unique product same-band/time matches, report absolute and fractional error deltas, ratio, residual to simple printed 0.001 rounding interval, by object/band/PHOTFLAG and available raw columns. Inspect only pinned local author scripts and documented SNANA/DES conventions for an exact conversion. Do not fit arbitrary additive/fractional coefficients to explain data or alter refits. DES15 separately as revision control.
